name: dev.workers.agent-arena-base.safe-send-check/safe-send-check
title: Safe-Send Check: crypto support triage, sanctions and scam screening
description: Crypto support-ticket triage, OFAC wallet screening, chat scam checks. x402 or prepaid USDC key.

tools.name: screen_wallet_ofac_sanctions
tools.description: Is this wallet sanctioned? Screens 1-20 addresses (EVM 0x on any chain, Bitcoin, TRON, Solana, Litecoin, XRP, Monero, Zcash, ...) against every digital-currency address on the US Treasury OFAC SDN list (18 asset lists, refreshed from the official data). Use before your agent sends, pays, accepts or onboards crypto. Exact match -> verdict match (do not transact). English + Chinese advice. Not legal advice. PAID: $0.005 per call or 5 prepaid credits, no account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base), or with a credits key bought by a plain USDC transfer (credits_quote / credits_claim, then header Authorization: Bearer ssk_...). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/ofac-sanctions-check.

address.description: Wallet address to screen (any chain; an ethereum:/bitcoin:/tron: URI prefix is stripped)

addresses.description: Optional: more addresses, comma-separated (total max 20 per call)

tools.name: screen_payout_recipient_list
tools.description: Before payroll, bounty / grant / contributor payouts, airdrops or refunds: up to 200 recipients (optionally with amounts) in ONE call. Per row: format, checksum, network, token-contract / burn addresses, pasted tx hashes or keys, OFAC SDN exact match. Whole list: duplicates (paid twice), look-alike pairs (address poisoning or typos), look-alikes of addresses you trust. Returns the rows to pay, the rows to hold and totals. PAID: $0.050 per call or 50 prepaid credits, no account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base), or with a credits key bought by a plain USDC transfer (credits_quote / credits_claim, then header Authorization: Bearer ssk_...). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/payout-check.

recipients.description: Up to 200 recipients: "address" or "address:amount", separated by commas or new lines (CSV "address,amount" lines and a JSON array of {address, amount} also work). Amounts are plain decimals in any unit.

network.description: Network you will pay on (base, ethereum, arbitrum, tron, solana, bitcoin, ...). Every row is checked against it. Omit to check formats only.

known.description: Optional: up to 50 addresses you already trust (comma-separated); rows that imitate one of them are held.

tools.name: check_crypto_chat_message_for_scams
tools.description: For community moderation bots and support desks: every link (known crypto-phishing domain list, brand look-alikes of ~90 wallets / exchanges / DeFi apps, homoglyph / punycode, typo-squats, free-hosting drainer pages, shorteners), scam scripts in English and Chinese (seed-phrase requests, fake support DMs, wallet "validation", fund recovery, giveaways, airdrop bait), and secrets the sender leaked (returned redacted). Returns allow / review / block, an action and a ready-to-post moderator reply in Chinese and English. PAID: $0.003 per call or 3 prepaid credits, no account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base), or with a credits key bought by a plain USDC transfer (credits_quote / credits_claim, then header Authorization: Bearer ssk_...). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/scam-message-check.

text.description: The chat message to check (max 4000 characters). "message" is accepted as an alias.

official_domains.description: Optional: your project's own domains, comma-separated (max 10). They are confirmed as official and look-alikes of them are flagged.

official_addresses.description: Optional: your official contract / treasury / deposit addresses, comma-separated (max 20). Addresses in the message that imitate them are flagged.

tools.name: sweep_crypto_chat_messages_for_scams
tools.description: For moderation bots and support desks clearing a backlog (back-scan a Telegram / Discord group when your bot joins, sweep a moderation queue): up to 25 messages, each with the full single-message analysis (phishing domains, brand look-alikes, scam scripts in English and Chinese, leaked keys redacted). Plus: campaigns (the same bad host, fake brand or scam script across messages and senders), per-sender recommendation (ban_candidate / mute_and_review / watch), the ids to remove / hold / warn, and ONE pinned group warning in Chinese and English. $0.002 a message instead of $0.003. PAID: $0.050 per call or 50 prepaid credits, no account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base), or with a credits key bought by a plain USDC transfer (credits_quote / credits_claim, then header Authorization: Bearer ssk_...). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/scam-message-batch.

messages.description: Up to 25 chat messages from one chat. Each item: {"id": "optional", "from": "optional sender", "text": "the message"}.

from.description: Sender name or user id (optional; enables per-sender counts)

official_domains.description: Optional: your project's own domains, comma-separated (max 10). Confirmed as official; look-alikes of them are flagged.

official_addresses.description: Optional: your official contract / treasury / deposit addresses, comma-separated (max 20). Addresses in the messages that imitate them are flagged.

detail.description: compact (default): per-message verdict, action, hosts, signal codes and summary. full: also the complete per-message report (links, findings, replies).

tools.name: triage_crypto_support_ticket
tools.description: For the helpdesk bots and agents of crypto exchanges, wallets and projects: one customer ticket in Chinese or English -> which of 21 common situations it is (deposit not credited, wrong network, missing memo / tag, stuck tx, bridge delay, tokens not showing, fake support DMs, address poisoning, leaked seed phrase, approval drain, phishing site, "fund recovery" scam, hacked account, no gas, ...), priority P0-P3, an honest recoverability call, the networks / coins / amounts / TxIDs / addresses found and what to ask for next, a ready reply in Chinese AND English, the internal note, a pre-filled escalation ticket and the red lines. A seed phrase or private key the customer pasted is caught and redacted (P0). Rule-based, no model. $0.04 a ticket. PAID: $0.040 per call or 40 prepaid credits, no account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base), or with a credits key bought by a plain USDC transfer (credits_quote / credits_claim, then header Authorization: Bearer ssk_...). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/support-ticket-triage.

ticket.description: The customer's support message (Chinese or English, max 2500 characters). "text" and "message" are accepted as aliases.

platform_name.description: Optional: your exchange / wallet / project name, filled into the reply (max 60 characters).

supported_networks.description: Optional: networks your platform accepts deposits on, comma-separated (ethereum, tron, bsc, arbitrum, optimism, base, polygon, solana, avalanche, ton, bitcoin, xrp; ERC20 / TRC20 / BEP20 work too). Decides the wrong-network reply automatically.

lang.description: Which reply language is primary (both are always returned). auto = the ticket's language.

official_domains.description: Optional: your official domains, comma-separated (max 10). Look-alikes in the ticket are flagged and the first one fills [official URL].

official_addresses.description: Optional: your official contract / deposit addresses, comma-separated (max 20). Look-alike addresses in the ticket are flagged.

tools.name: check_crypto_address_before_sending
tools.description: Before sending crypto: detects the chain family (EVM, TRON, Bitcoin, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Solana, TON, XRP), verifies checksums, catches token-contract / burn addresses as recipients, invisible or look-alike characters, pasted tx hashes or private keys, testnet addresses and address / network mismatches (e.g. a 0x address on TRC-20); flags a missing memo / tag for exchange deposits. Verdict ok / caution / incomplete / do_not_send. PAID: $0.001 per call or 1 prepaid credits, no account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base), or with a credits key bought by a plain USDC transfer (credits_quote / credits_claim, then header Authorization: Bearer ssk_...). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/address-check.

network.description: Network you intend to send on. Aliases accepted: ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, bnb, trc20, solana, bitcoin, eip155:<id>. Omit to check format only.

recipient.description: Who receives: exchange deposit address, your own wallet, or someone else

memo.description: Memo / destination tag you plan to include (TON, XRP, XLM, ...; max 100 chars)

tools.name: detect_address_poisoning_lookalike
tools.description: Compare a destination address with up to 50 addresses you already trust (address book, past counterparties): catches vanity "dust attack" look-alikes with the same first and last characters. Verdict exact_match / lookalike / partial / no_match. PAID: $0.001 per call or 1 prepaid credits, no account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base), or with a credits key bought by a plain USDC transfer (credits_quote / credits_claim, then header Authorization: Bearer ssk_...). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/poison-check.

address.description: Destination address you are about to send to

tools.name: payment_options
tools.description: FREE. Prices, the receiving address, the x402-over-MCP retry format, and how to use a prepaid credits key instead (bought with a plain USDC transfer, no x402 client needed).

tools.name: credits_quote
tools.description: FREE, no x402 needed. Returns a quote id and the EXACT USDC amount to send on Base from your address to this service. After sending, call credits_claim with the quote id to receive an ssk_ key. 1 credit = $0.001 of list price (OFAC check 5, chat message 3, chat sweep of 25 messages 50, address check 1, payout list 50).

pack.description: starter $0.25 (300 credits), team $1 (1,500 credits), ops $5 (9,000 credits). Default team.

from.description: The Base address you will send the USDC from (0x + 40 hex). Only a transfer from that address can claim the quote.

tools.name: credits_claim
tools.description: FREE. After the transfer from credits_quote has landed on Base, returns your ssk_ credits key (claiming again returns the same key). Then set the MCP header "Authorization: Bearer <key>" or pass _meta["safe-send/credits-key"].

quote.description: The quote id from credits_quote (q_ + 22 characters).

tools.name: credits_balance
tools.description: FREE. Credits left and calls made on the key sent as the MCP header "Authorization: Bearer ssk_..." (or _meta["safe-send/credits-key"]).
